Cables may also appear loose. These issues prevent safe operation. We fix broken garage door springs for Des Plaines residents. Our service trucks carry common torsion and extension springs. We dispatch 24 hours Monday through Saturday for urgent repairs. You will receive an upfront, flat-rate quote before any work begins. Booking your spring repair service online qualifies you for a 10% discount. We restore your garage door's balance and safety quickly, so your schedule stays on track. We test every door's balance and safety reverse function after repair.
localContext: Des Plaines garages see heavy use. Homes in Downtown Des Plaines and the River Road corridor often have older garage doors. These doors endure frequent cycles, especially with residents needing early access for O'Hare flights or shift work. A spring failing at 4 AM demands prompt service. Post-war Cape Cods and ranches in Cumberland and Orchard Place often feature springs nearing their lifespan. Additionally, properties near the Des Plaines River can experience damp garage slabs. This moisture accelerates rust on metal components, including bottom brackets and sometimes even spring coils, leading to premature failure. Our technicians understand these local demands and arrive prepared for Des Plaines’ specific conditions.

problemSigns.detail: A sudden, sharp noise often indicates a spring has snapped.

problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: Springs counterbalance the door's weight; without them, it becomes too heavy to lift manually or for the opener.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: Torsion springs break by separating, leaving a clear gap in the coil.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: This can happen if one spring breaks on a two-spring system, or if the opener struggles with a compromised spring.
Broken springs relieve tension, causing the lift cables to become loose or detach from the drum.
